title: Claim-Ready Homebook
user: A renter or homeowner who wants an insurance-ready, portable record of belongings, serials, receipts, and storage locations before a stressful loss.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA for item photos, value/date/serial/receipt, container and room location, plus an encrypted export that creates a readable PDF/CSV claim packet.
success_measure: A pilot user can create an export for 50 items in under ten minutes and open it on a second device without an account.
constraints: Local-only by default; optional encrypted export with user-held passphrase; communicate that insurer requirements and valuations vary.
